    • createUser

      @Transactional public UserResponse createUser(CreateUserRequest request)
      Creates a new user account with duplicate validation and BCrypt password encryption.

      Security Rule: Never store user passwords directly as plain text. passwordEncoder.encode() computes a secure one-way cryptographic hash with random salt.

      Specified by:
      createUser in interface UserService
      Parameters:
      request - input payload containing username, email, password, and role
      Returns:
      the newly created user response DTO
